source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Errata rewriting [Dauntless Defenders](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.gate-warden-lance.dauntless-defenders) (Gate Warden Lance). As battle round 1 starts, pick 2 objectives as your foundations and put a 40mm circular foundation marker on each. An **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit counts as on your defensive line if part of one of its models' base (or hull, if it has no base) crosses a line drawn between any parts of the 2 markers.

While on that line, the unit has **Against the Horde**:

- its attacks that target a **visible** enemy unit may disregard any or all **Hit roll** modifiers
- its models' weapons have **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**

defensiveLine.start: any part of first foundation marker
defensiveLine.end: any part of second foundation marker
defensiveLine.unitQualifiesWhen: any part of at least one model base crosses line, or hull for baseless model

typedMechanics.beneficiary: friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit on defensive line

againstTheHorde.mayIgnore: any subset of hit roll modifiers
